title: SentinelResponseEvent
description: Schema for Service Manager message SM8. This event is published by the Service Manager in response to GetSentinelCommand and returns a reference to the requested Sentinel entity.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be sentinelResponseEvent.

originator.description: Property. Component that generated the response event.

relatedGetSentinelCommand.description: Relationship. Reference to the triggering OM2 GetSentinelCommand entity id.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the Sentinel response event was generated.

relatedSentinel.description: Relationship. Sentinel entity returned by the Service Manager.
